name: POST /api/consents/purposes - Register typed purpose

payload.description: Send transactional and marketing emails about appointments and offers.

description: Registers a typed processing purpose in the per-app purpose registry (FR-CNS-4) and emits consent.purpose.registered.v1. Returns 201 with the purpose. purpose_id, app_id and description are mandatory non-empty strings; legal_basis must be one of consent | contract | legitimate-interest | vital | public-task | legal-obligation; default_jurisdictions is optional, defaults to an empty array, and must be an array of strings when supplied. Edge cases: re-registering an existing purpose_id is a 409 rather than an upsert, so the call is not idempotent; string fields are trimmed, so whitespace-only values count as missing; a non-array or mixed-type default_jurisdictions is a 400; requires a valid JWT.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Bearer token fails JWT verification or is expired (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Request body is absent or not a JSON object
Any of purpose_id, app_id, description is absent or whitespace-only

errorCases.message: legal_basis must be one of consent, contract, legitimate-interest, vital, public-task, legal-obligation
errorCases.when: legal_basis is missing or outside the closed set

errorCases.message: default_jurisdictions must be an array of strings
errorCases.when: default_jurisdictions is supplied but is not an array, or contains a non-string element
The insert raises a duplicate-key violation - this purpose_id already exists in the registry
Any other registerPurpose failure (database error, event-emit failure)
